subject: business-studies
title: The 4 Ps Adventure
welcome_lead: Product, Price, Place, Promotion — meet the marketing mix. 🅿️
meta_desc: Marketing & Customers Adventure 2 — KS3 Business Studies on the 4 Ps marketing mix.
final_note: You learned the 4 Ps: Product, Price, Place and Promotion — and how they work together.

concepts.def: The four Ps a business uses to sell
Unique Selling Point that stands out

walkthroughs.body_html:
The Product must do its job and look good.

The Price must feel fair. Too high = no sales. Too low = no profit.

A USP is the one thing that makes your product different — like Innocent's funny labels. 😊

Place is where customers can buy it.

Options:

  • A shop on the high street.
  • A supermarket shelf.
  • Online via a website or app.
  • A market stall.

Match the place to the customer.

Promotion tells people the product exists.

  • Ads on TV, YouTube, Instagram.
  • Influencers who recommend it.
  • Special offers — BOGOF, discounts.
  • Sponsorship of teams or events.

Good promotion turns 'never heard of it' into 'I want one'. 📢

mcqs.q: Which is NOT one of the 4 Ps?
Which sector does manufacturing belong to?
options: Manufacturing is in the tertiary sector along with services.
Manufacturing is in the primary sector because it makes things.
Cash flow only matters at year-end.
The secondary sector — which transforms raw materials from the primary sector (farming, mining) into finished goods.
